sentences.en: In her home, kitchen garbage was fed to the pigs.
sentences.zh: 在她的家里，厨房里的垃圾被喂给猪。

sentences.en: All the apples that fall are eaten by the pigs.
sentences.zh: 所有掉下来的苹果都被猪吃了。

sentences.en: Yeah, right, he'll get his act together. When pigs fly.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然他会振作起来。等到猪长翅膀飞上天吧。（意即：绝无可能）
